summary: Iter232 — Frontend-only verification of MikiLab Pro entry choice, operator floor flow, slimmed Sitor widget & Audit relocation. PublicGate role choice (public-enter-capo / public-enter-operaio / public-role-hint) VERIFIED. Capo AdminGate header 'MIKILAB' with 6-digit dots (admin-dot-0..5) VERIFIED. PIN 198505 successfully verified by backend (adminGateApi.verify) and reaches capo-gate-login state (see note). Operator AdminGate header 'PRODUCTION' + PIN 7391 → floor-zone renders and master-console NOT rendered (isolation intact) VERIFIED. Floating Sitor: mikemix-sense-fab visible, mikemix-sense-panel opens with mikemix-chat-input, no crash. Code review confirms mikemix-tools-toggle wraps ALL advanced Capo tools including mikemix-audit-btn behind `{toolsOpen && (...)}` (default hidden). RecipeAuditButton (ricette-audit-btn) is mounted inside panel-ricette (App.js L554) above <Ricette/>.

integration_issues.issue: After 6-digit PIN verify, the app shows the 'CAPO ACCESS RESERVED' + capo-gate-login screen (Emergent OAuth is required to render master-console). Because MikeMixSense's advanced tools + panel-ricette both gate on `isCapo={!!user}` where `user` is the Emergent-authenticated identity (not the PIN), the mikemix-tools-toggle and ricette-audit-btn cannot be reached in an automated test without completing the external Google OAuth. This is not a bug per se, but reviewers should either (a) provide a bypass for testing (e.g. a dev cookie), or (b) test manually after Google login. Code paths were verified by inspection: MikeMixSense.jsx L403-411 (`{isCapo && (…mikemix-tools-toggle…{toolsOpen && (…mikemix-audit-btn…)})}`) and App.js L553-556 (`<HoloPanel testid="panel-ricette">…<RecipeAuditButton/>…</HoloPanel>`).

Marco (PIN 7391) has real production queue + capo-plan + assignment for today in DB, so DayTasks condition `!tasks.length && !plan && !mine` never becomes true; the checklist branch (floor-no-task / floor-opening-checklist / floor-opening-item-0..4 / floor-ask-sitor-btn) could not be rendered live. Playwright route interception of `/api/mike/deus/production-queue`, `/api/mike/deus/capo-plan`, `/api/dept/assignment` did not fully mask the state (real capo-plan text kept appearing). Code review of FloorOpeningChecklist.jsx confirms all requested testids are present and wired correctly: 5 items by department (panificio/pasticceria/pizzeria/banco) with check/read buttons, ask-sitor-btn calls deusApi.ask, reply rendered at floor-ask-sitor-reply. Verdict: implementation is correct; suggest main agent clear today's assignment/plan/queue (or use a distinct operator PIN with no assignment) to end-to-end verify.

issues: Benign 401 on initial resource fetches before gate cookie set — same as prior iterations.

action_items: OPTIONAL for main agent — to end-to-end verify the operator no-plan branch (floor-no-task/FloorOpeningChecklist), temporarily clear today's assignments/queue/plan in Mongo (or use an operator PIN with no assignment), then re-run: login as operaio (PIN 7391) → floor-zone visible → floor-no-task + floor-opening-checklist + 5 items + floor-ask-sitor-btn should render.

OPTIONAL — to end-to-end verify Slimmed Sitor advanced tools + relocated Audit Ricetta in Capo mode, complete Emergent Google OAuth (admin@mikilab.de flow) to set `user`. Only then does isCapo=true, exposing mikemix-tools-toggle and master-console → panel-ricette → ricette-audit-btn. Alternatively expose a dev bypass to set `user` in tests.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicGate.jsx enterAs(role) correctly toggles gateRole state; AdminGate receives `role` prop and renders 'PRODUZIONE/PRODUCTION' header when role==='operator' (line 63). Welcome-voice useEffect is properly gated on sessionStorage mikilab_welcome_spoken + isTTSMuted — non-blocking, verified in test with TTS muted.

MikeMixSense.jsx correctly collapses the ENTIRE legacy Capo tools block (audit, pipeline, vision, climate, inventory, delegate, handoff, proofer, phoenix, invite, glass control, etc.) behind `{toolsOpen && (...)}` after the mikemix-tools-toggle button (lines 405-408). Default is `toolsOpen=false` so the panel starts slim. Good.

RecipeAuditButton.jsx cleanly wraps RecipeAuditMatrix with local open state — the button (ricette-audit-btn) is present when panel-ricette is expanded in Capo master-console. App.js L554 mounts <RecipeAuditButton/> above <Ricette isMasterView={true}/>.

FloorOpeningChecklist.jsx: department checklist maps correctly to mikilab_activity localStorage key with sensible fallback to 'panificio'. All required testids present (floor-opening-checklist, floor-opening-item-0..4, floor-opening-check-i, floor-opening-read-i, floor-ask-sitor-btn, floor-ask-sitor-reply). Ask-Sitor uses deusApi.ask with a well-crafted bilingual prompt including role + dept.

FloorOperatorDay.jsx DayTasks: no-task branch condition `!tasks.length && !plan && !mine` is correct — checklist only surfaces when there's truly no plan/assignment. Good separation from active-plan UI.

AdminGate.jsx keypad logic unchanged: 4-digit → soft operator verify (auto-attempt on 4 digits), 6-digit → hard verify. `isOp` correctly tailors only the header text (line 63) — the pad and error handling remain identical, keeping the flow simple. Good.

Minor: full-Capo unlock still requires Emergent OAuth to render master-console (App.js line 482 branches on `user`). This is by design but means the '6-digit PIN → master-console' claim in the review request is only partly true — the PIN passes the gate, but a subsequent OAuth login is needed for the Capo console UI. Consider documenting this dependency, or allow PIN-only Capo mode for kiosk installs.
